defs.def: not sensible; stupid 不理智的；疯狂的；愚蠢的；傻的

ex.s: They went crazy with the purple quartz rock.
ex.t: 他们为紫色石英岩而疯狂。

ex.s: If you can start the conversation with a question other than “What do you do for a living?", you'll be able to get a lot more interesting conversation out of whomever it is you're talking to. ____37 ___. it can bring in "I have this old, broken-down vehicle" or "I rode the bus with these crazy people who were laughing at silly jokes in the back." It just opens up conversation.
ex.t: 如果您可以用“您做什么工作？”以外的问题开始对话，您将能够从与您交谈的人那里获得更多有趣的对话。____ 37 ___。它可以带来“我有这辆破旧的旧车”或“我和这些疯狂的人一起乘坐公共汽车，他们在后面嘲笑愚蠢的笑话。“这只是开启了对话。

ex.s: What puzzles Lily's friends is                   she always has so many crazy ideas.
ex.t: 让莉莉的朋友们困惑的是                   她总是有那么多疯狂的想法。

ex.s: “I have an idea, but it might be a little crazy,” smiled Mom.
ex.t: “我有个主意，但可能有点疯狂，”妈妈笑着说。

ex.s: This got me thinking how English can be a crazy language to learn.
ex.t: 这让我想到，英语学起来可真是一门疯狂的语言。

ex.s: Oh, why are people so crazy?
ex.t: 哦，为什么人们这么疯狂？
英语是一门疯狂的语言。

defs.def: very enthusiastic or excited about sth 常构成复合词

ex.s: I’m crazy about basketball, and pretty good at it too, which is probably why I was so mad when we lost our last match.
ex.t: 我痴迷于篮球，而且打得相当好，这可能就是为什么上次比赛我们输了时我那么生气。

defs.def: liking sb very much; in love with sb 迷恋的；爱上的
mentally ill; insane 患精神病的；精神失常（或错乱）的

ex.s: The moment I got off the plane, I ran like crazy through the airport building and jumped into the first taxi on the rank without a second thought.
ex.t: 我一下飞机，就发疯似的跑过航站楼，想都没想就跳上了排队的第一辆出租车。

ex.s: The moment I got off the plane, I ran like crazy through the airport building and jumped into the first taxi on the rank without a second thought.

ex.s: “It sounds crazy to talk about guilt-free fur-unless you understand that the nutria are destroying vast wetlands every year”, says Cree McCree, project director of Righteous Fur.
ex.t: “谈论没有愧疚感的毛皮听起来很疯狂——除非你明白海狸鼠每年都在摧毁大片的湿地，”Righteous Fur项目总监克里·麦克里说。

ex.s: The fur trade kept nutria check for decades，but when the market for nutria collapsed in the late 1980s，the cat-sized animals multiplied like crazy.
ex.t: 皮草贸易使海狸鼠的数量得到控制了几十年，但20世纪80年代末海狸鼠市场崩溃后，这种猫大小的动物疯狂繁殖。

ex.s: Many people go crazy trying to figure out how to spend time with friends, family, work, play, etc ____13____ Find ways to enjoy them in a combined manner.
ex.t: 许多人疯狂地想办法如何安排时间与朋友、家人、工作、娱乐等共度。____13____ 找到方法以组合的方式享受它们。

ex.s: He hums it over and over again, and you are about to go crazy.
ex.t: 对于那些渴望一些安宁和宁静的人来说，声音现在可以创造寂静。
